request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only the colours of his clothes and skin: the red tunic becomes near-black dark brown leather with two lighter brown stitched hide patches; the red bandana becomes a black headband with hazard yellow diagonal stripes; dirty cream bandage wraps round both forearms; his skin a brighter, more saturated yellow-olive green. Keep the face, ears, dagger, belt, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
